The success_bonus (100) is never triggered in final evaluation. The next edit should: (1) Increase the success_bonus to 150 to make terminal success more attractive without the extreme jump to 200 that caused out_of_bounds behavior. (2) Add a small time_penalty (-0.1 per step) to discourage timeout and encourage faster landing. (3) Keep fuel_penalty at -0.1 but consider making it conditional on being far from pad (y > 0.5) to avoid penalizing necessary main engine use near ground. (4) Keep shaping_reward, orientation_penalty, leg_contact_bonus, vertical_speed_penalty, and crash_penalty unchanged. The hypothesis is that a moderate success_bonus increase combined with a small time_penalty will push the policy to complete landings rather than timeout, without introducing out_of_bounds behavior.
